name: bazaar-companion
description: Local live companion for The Bazaar: follows the run from Player.log and the screen, ranks the choices.

scripts.setup:vision: cd vision && uv venv -q --python 3.11 .venv && uv pip install -q --python .venv/bin/python -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/python extract_art.py && .venv/bin/python matcher.py --rebuild
